note: Runs trained BEFORE the terminated/truncated fix. Budget exhaustion was flagged `truncated`, so Stable-Baselines3 bootstrapped gamma * V(s_final) on top of the terminal reward. Every agent converged to the same policy: maximum dwell, 6 measurements, ride the 60 ms budget (63 ms), never stop on its own. Kept as evidence of the bug; every model in results/models was retrained after the fix.

stop probability collapsing early with no entropy bonus: ent_coef 0.01 and 0.03, outcome unchanged
belief summary not sufficient for search: added 40-bin f0 and 8-bin log Q marginals, outcome unchanged
placement too hard to learn end to end: handed placement to expected information gain, still never stopped
